data.timestamp_convention: New York wall clock encoded as UTC

predeclared_definition.burst: maximal same-side raw-trade run with adjacent receive-time gaps <= gap_ms
predeclared_definition.directional_levels: BUY: (last ask-first ask)/0.25; SELL: (first bid-last bid)/0.25
predeclared_definition.entry: strongest qualifying burst per minute; next minute open

checks.name: no CV block worse than -2x mean block

ml.note: The single fixed classifier filters the unchanged occupied default population; no algorithms, thresholds, or feature subsets were searched.

notes: All raw tables were queried read-only; caches live under sandbox/.cache.
Day/time/side, sizing, and cost tables are diagnostics and are not adopted.
The fixed ML test does not authorize a second model or threshold search.
S4 is rejected unless both the standard promotion gate and <=30% cofire pass.
The raw Databento history ends 2026-07-16; no later Bookmap proxy is spliced.
